name: comp-220

frames.best_why: The menu is open with all five coloured dots and their labels, and Completed carries the tick.

tagline: A dropdown of statuses, each marked by a coloured dot.
summary: A labelled dropdown whose trigger shows the current status as a coloured dot and a word. Opening it lists Completed, In Progress, Pending, Cancelled and Failed, each with its own dot and the chosen row ticked.
appearance: A small Status select caption sits above a rounded trigger holding a green dot, the word Completed and a chevron. Opened, a dark panel drops below with five rows, each a small coloured dot and a status word, the current one ending in a tick.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger drops the list; hovering a row lifts it to a lighter grey, and clicking one sets the trigger's dot and word and closes the panel. The clip ends on Pending.
demo_content: Status select label; Completed, In Progress, Pending, Cancelled, Failed options
search_phrases: pick a status from a dropdown
dropdown with green blue and red dots
change the status of a record
menu of states with colour markers
use_when: Changing a record's state in a list or detail panel, where colour helps status read at a glance.
avoid_when: The five states are fixed in the file, and the dots lean on colour alone, so a new workflow needs edits.
customise: The five statuses, their dot colours and the default value are written in the file; edit them there. Trigger padding, dot size and menu spacing are classes in the same file.
weight_why: One listbox popup with five short rows and a small open and close animation.

a11y.note: The label is tied to the trigger and the dots are hidden decoration, so options read by name; the open and close animation has no reduced-motion guard.

issues: A hovered row's coloured dot washes out to white, dropping the colour cue exactly when pointed at.
Completed and Cancelled dots sit close in hue on a dark panel.
polish_why: Colour-coded rows and a tidy trigger; the hovered dot losing its colour is the one slip.
